caption: MCP Method Not Found Error
description:
A JSON-RPC error indicating that the requested method does not exist or is not available.

In MCP, a server returns this error when a client invokes a method the server does not implement — either a genuinely unknown method, or one gated behind a server capability the server did not advertise (e.g., calling `prompts/list` when the `prompts` capability was not advertised).

A request that requires a client capability the client did not declare is signalled instead by {@link MissingRequiredClientCapabilityError} (`-32021`). Generated from the pinned MCP schema (2026-07-28 MethodNotFoundError).
name: mcp_method_not_found_error

mcp_code.description: MCP member `code` (required by the protocol): The error type that occurred.

mcp_data_json.description: MCP member `data`: Additional information about the error. The value of this member is defined by the sender (e.g. detailed error information, nested errors etc.).

mcp_message.description: MCP member `message` (required by the protocol): A short description of the error. The message SHOULD be limited to a concise single sentence.
